normal-checkout.title: Normal checkout
normal-checkout.description: Buy one item and verify that the cart is cleared.

cart-failure.title: Cart fails to clear
cart-failure.description: Observe a successful order response while the deliberately failing cart retains its item. This fault can take a few minutes.

payment-unreachable.title: Payment is unavailable
payment-unreachable.description: Observe an error response and a retained cart when the simulated payment service is unavailable.

mcp-session-id.title: MCP reads the right cart
mcp-session-id.description: Seed distinct carts for two synthetic shoppers, then verify MCP and HTTP reads stay aligned by shopper.

shared-cart-conflict.title: Ordered conflicting cart intents
shared-cart-conflict.description: Run two separate sequential clients against one synthetic cart: actor A adds an item, then actor B clears it; retain both raw responses and the final readback.

shared-cart-overlap-diagnostic.title: Shared-cart client-window diagnostic
shared-cart-overlap-diagnostic.description: Launch two independent clients against one synthetic cart and record whether their measured request windows intersect. Either OBSERVED or NOT_OBSERVED is a valid diagnostic; neither result proves overlap inside the service handler.
